mapper.select: SELECT u.name AS name, s.academic_status AS status, d.name AS departmentName, s.grade_level AS grade, u.login_id AS studentNo, u.email AS email, u.phone_number AS phoneNum, u.address AS address, c.name AS collegeName, au.name AS advisorName, s.admission_year AS admissionYear, ( SELECT sgs.total_credits FROM student_grade_summaries sgs WHERE sgs.student_id = s.id ORDER BY sgs.semester_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS credits FROM students s JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id JOIN departments d ON s.department_id = d.id JOIN colleges c ON d.college_id = c.id JOIN professors adv ON s.advisor_id = adv.id JOIN users au ON adv.user_id = au.id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId}
